review_evidence: A complete proposition scan found 4,764 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across 321 current-primary files.

The retained tree spans cryptographic foundations, Fiat–Shamir, program logics, oracle computations, lattice cryptography, hash signatures, verified external-algorithm bridges, and theorem-rich examples such as ElGamal, Schnorr, Pedersen, PIR, Regev, and PRF reductions.
Import roots, tests, widgets, and interoperability modules are intertwined with the formal interfaces and no source-local lossless hard-exclusion class was established in this review.
